body.summary: 5a4d776a + e52f50e2: CodeReviewSubject.buildRecord is the general BuildRecord and the subject gains testRecord; DEFAULT_DEPS supplies readStoryBuildRecord and readTestRecord. After the first gate's finding, readStoryBuildRecord requires meta.workflow 'build', this Story's epicHash and storyId, a string createdAt, an object (non-array) body, and tasks (when present) with a string id and boolean-or-absent passed; an absent record is warned about. subject.test.ts covers each misshapen case and the warning; six falsifying mutations (one per check) each fail it, plus the earlier three (no build reader, no test reader, no shape check). tsc clean.
